surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Fantilli sparks a Blue Jackets comeback
paras: Auston Matthews got the scoring started for the Maple Leafs on the power play late in the first. Damon Severson tied it up for Columbus with 17 seconds left in the period, and Jake McCabe restored the Leafs’ lead with just five seconds left in the period. Teddy Blueger stretched the lead to 3-1 early in the second, but the Maple Leafs didn’t score again. Adam Fantilli cut Toronto’s lead to 3-2 on the power play late in the period, and Matthew Knies made it 3-3 with less than five minutes left. Zach Werenski put the Blue Jackets ahead for good 52 seconds later.

The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Cam Talbot made 23 saves for the Blue Jackets, and Anthony Stolarz stopped 31 of 35 at the other end. The Blue Jackets improved to 9-12-0, seventh in the Metropolitan. The Maple Leafs are still last in the Atlantic. They are winless in nine (0-8-1).

items.text: Steven Lorentz played his first game back in Toronto.
Adam Fantilli scored again against Toronto, and has seven goals in eleven games against them since 2023-24.
Zach Werenski has a point in four straight games, with a goal in each of the last three.
Jake McCabe scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 28 (32 games played since).
